notes: 25 categories total; labels are mutually exclusive and intended for single-label classification.

categories.label: Educational and Academic
categories.definition: Lectures, study guides, curriculum-aligned explainers, academic content.

categories.label: How-To/Tutorials

categories.label: Science and Technology
categories.definition: Research breakdowns, engineering, tech reviews and demos.
examples: M2 MacBook Air Review: 6 Months Later

categories.label: Wellbeing and Mindfulness

categories.label: Music and Arts
categories.definition: Music performances, visual art, creative process.

categories.label: Sports and Fitness
categories.definition: Matches, highlights, training, exercise programmes.

categories.label: Travel and Nature
categories.definition: Travel logs, wildlife, outdoor exploration.

categories.label: Product Reviews

categories.label: Lifestyle and Hobbies

categories.label: Comedy

categories.label: Finance

categories.label: Crime and Investigations

categories.label: Gambling and Betting

categories.label: Controversial and Conspiracy Theories

categories.label: Sexual and Explicit
categories.definition: Sexually suggestive themes or thumbnails; adult-oriented content.

categories.label: Scams and Get-Rich-Quick

categories.label: Hate, Harrassment and Bullying
categories.definition: Content attacking individuals or groups; slurs, dog-piling.

categories.label: Violent and Graphic
categories.definition: Graphic violence, injuries, fight footage, gore.

categories.label: Other
categories.definition: Low-signal or ambiguous content that does not fit other labels.
